requirement: Pydantic v2 CampaignPromotion model validating promotional discounts with model_config extra='forbid', start_date and end_date (end_date > start_date), discount_percent (0.0 < discount <= 100.0), minimum_spend (>= 0.0), and a model_validator(mode='after') enforcing that when is_tiered is True, tier_thresholds list must be non-empty and strictly monotonically increasing.
skeleton: Pydantic v2 model with model_config extra forbidden and multi-field temporal/tiered validators.
caption: A single pydantic v2 model, CampaignPromotion, whose model_config sets extra to forbid so any unknown key in the input is rejected. Fields: campaign_id is a string between 3 and 64 characters; start_date and end_date are datetimes; discount_percent is a float constrained with gt=0.0 and le=100.0; minimum_spend is a float defaulting to 0.0 with ge=0.0; is_tiered is a bool defaulting to False; tier_thresholds is a list of floats with an empty-list default_factory. A model_validator in after mode named validate_campaign returns self after its checks: it raises ValueError when end_date is less than or equal to start_date, and when is_tiered is True it raises ValueError for an empty threshold list, for any threshold at or below zero, and for a list that is not strictly increasing, which it detects by comparing the list with its sorted form and its length with the size of its set. When is_tiered is False the thresholds are not inspected at all. A calculate_discount method returns 0.0 when the order amount is below minimum_spend; without tiers it returns the amount times discount_percent over 100 rounded to two decimals; with tiers it counts the thresholds the amount reaches, returns 0.0 when none qualify, scales discount_percent by the fraction of qualifying tiers capped at the full percent, and rounds the result to two decimals.

plan.intent: Validate a promotional campaign and compute its discount
constraints: An end date not after the start date raises ValueError
The discount percent is above 0 and at most 100, and the minimum spend is not negative
A tiered campaign raises ValueError unless its thresholds are non-empty, positive, and strictly increasing
An amount below the minimum spend gets no discount

rationale.teaches: Pydantic v2 cross-field validation: extra fields forbidden, end after start, discount and spend ranges, tier thresholds checked only when tiered, and an after-validator that returns self.
rationale.why: A model validator that returns None or checks the inverted flag still imports and even instantiates for happy-path input. Only boundary payloads expose it, so the family exists to supply those payloads.

ops.docstring: Promotion campaign model whose fields are validated against each other.

ops.stmt: from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

candidates.why_wrong: Unknown fields are accepted instead of rejected, so a typo in a payload key passes validation silently.
end_date equal to start_date is accepted, so a zero-length campaign validates.
Tier thresholds are checked only when is_tiered is False, so a tiered promotion with empty or unsorted thresholds validates.
The after-validator returns None, so validation produces None instead of the model instance.
is_tiered defaults to True, so every promotion that omits thresholds fails unless the caller explicitly opts out.
